customers.evidence: Our clients’ systems support modern society. In making them faster, more productive, and more secure, we don’t just make business work better.

employees.evidence: digeys, AI-powered workers who can relieve employees of their most repetitive, mundane tasks

dei.evidence: IBM SkillsBuild is a free education program that provides valuable skills and career opportunities to traditionally underrepresented communities in technology.

environment.evidence: In 2021, we furthered our tradition of leadership in sustainability, announcing a goal of net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2030 across all the countries in which we operate.

community.evidence: The IBM Sustainability Accelerator brings IBM technology, resources and experts to projects supporting vulnerable communities around the world.

integrity.evidence: Learn how IBM protects our clients and business with security and privacy practices.

innovation.evidence: IBM is always on the hunt for what’s next.

result.analyst_notes: Confident, aspirational first-person plural voice ('we make the world work better') led by the CEO and framed around client impact and society. Commitments are stated absolutely (net-zero by 2030) and innovation is the dominant theme, with research and history heavily featured. Shareholder, safety and financial value are absent; the page is largely promotional and includes navigation chrome.
